title: Mermaid scene I did in 2 evenings
author: vlaaad
selftext:
I used the Defold game engine and Blender for 3D modeling. Used ImageGen for the initial scene look and feel, then used Codex for around 2 days to make it look like the initial image.

Initially, I set up the agent to take a screenshot and use a script to compare it with the reference image: [https://github.com/vlaaad/mermaid/blob/main/Blonde-Mermaid-in-Atlantis-Ruins.png?raw=true](https://github.com/vlaaad/mermaid/blob/main/Blonde-Mermaid-in-Atlantis-Ruins.png?raw=true) 

Left it running overnight, iterated on how it should approach it. Obviously it's not quite like the reference, but in general I think it looks nice and produces a satisfying picture. 

I wanted to both make it look nice and keep it performant on the web. You can check it out yourself here: [https://vlaaad.github.io/mermaid/](https://vlaaad.github.io/mermaid/)  
Mobile controls: touch and hold the left side of the screen to move; swipe the right side to turn.

comments.author: Serasul
comments.body:
\- Color correction to tint assets and main character more  
\- stone assets need little more color variation  
\- slight wave water effect with help of shaders  
\- more water movement effects behind the main character when she is moving  
\- fine grain shader effect because the water looks to clear.
